answer_1.quote: We explore knowledge expression in knowledge‑grounded conversation and evaluate our model on two benchmarks of knowledge‑grounded conversation: Wizard of Wikipedia (Wizard) and CMU Document Grounded Conversation (CMU_DoG).

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. Following ..., we choose PPL and unigram F1 as the metrics to evaluate the appropriateness. We further use Distinct-1/2 (D-1/2)... We also employ classification accuracy as the evaluation metrics for style control experiments. ... we provide automatic evaluation results on more metrics (i.e., BLEU-1, METEOR, and ROUGE-L).

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 300 examples... recruit 6 well‑educated native speakers to do qualitative analysis on the responses generated by our model and all baselines. The annotators need to judge the quality of the responses from four aspects (i.e., fluency, context coherence, knowledge relevance and style consistency), and assign a score from {0, 1, 2}.
